title: Assistant_Pepe_32B: Human-Centric Qwen-3 Creative Fine-Tune
summary: A creative, high-personality fine-tune of the Qwen-3-32B model designed to eliminate corporate 'assistant slop' and neutral glazing. It features a baked-in unhinged persona with integrated negativity bias for more authentic, human-like creative interactions.
research_notes: Consistently ranks high on uncensored intelligence leaderboards; features 32K-64K context support with unique 'anti-slop' training to avoid GPT-style writing patterns.

evolution.summary: The series transitioned from early Tenebră-30B variants to Llama-3.1 (70B) in April 2026, culminating in this Qwen-3-32B version that successfully integrates a lateral-thinking persona directly into the weights.
